thread:
deploy-bot: Starting image build -> ghcr.io/redwood/inference:rc-2026-03-02 (commit a1b2c3d). multi-arch manifest will be pushed to registry. kicking off build. :docker:

ops-jenkins: build finished in 4m12s, layers uploaded. creating manifest and attempting push to registry (ghcr.io).

deploy-bot: Push attempt 1 -> manifest upload failed: 504 Gateway Timeout from registry endpoint.
```
PUT /v2/redwood/inference/manifests/sha256:... 504
response: Gateway Timeout
```

maria: @deploy-bot can you auto-retry with backoff? if this doesn't clear in ~10m we should pin canary to last stable image and hold rollout. :eyes:

samir: Agreed. If registry is flaky we should avoid partial canary traffic. Suggest pin to `ghcr.io/redwood/inference:prod-20260301` as fallback.

release-coordinator: I'm opening a quick rollback playbook entry. Action plan: 1) try 3 retries with increasing backoff, 2) if still failing after retries -> pin canary to prod tag + abort rollout, 3) notify infra to mirror image to fallback-registry.

deploy-bot: Retry #1 scheduled in 30s.

deploy-bot: Retry #1 -> failed (502 Bad Gateway). logging error and backoff to 90s.

ops-jenkins: Kicked a mirror job to mirror.registry.internal for the image just in case.

deploy-bot: Retry #2 -> failed (connection reset). attempting Retry #3 (final) in 2m.

maria: If Retry #3 fails, ops: please proceed with pin + notify customers in #announcements. We have a short change window but we can't risk canary serving incomplete layers.

deploy-bot: Retry #3 -> SUCCESS. manifest pushed, digest sha256:3f5d9c8a..., locations: ghcr.io (primary), mirror.registry.internal (mirrored).

samir: Nice. Can we verify all architectures are present? quick `skopeo inspect` or `docker manifest inspect` on eu-west should show amd64/arm64.

ops-jenkins: Verified: manifest lists amd64, arm64. pulled a canary instance in us-central and eu-west successfully.

release-coordinator: Proceeding with canary rollout. Tagging release notes: "rc-2026-03-02 — runtime kernel selection + improved batching heuristics". Will monitor token latency/95p for 30m then continue. :shipit: 

maria: I'll keep the pin ready for 1 hour in case we see regression. If anything pops up we revert to `prod-20260301` and abort the rest of the rollout.

samir: Leaving canary at 10% traffic for now, ramp to 50% after 30m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: canary tag `rc-2026-03-02` -> routing at 10%. health checks green.

release-coordinator: Closing thread but keeping watch. Will post a summary in the release doc and link to this thread. :white_check_mark:
